opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research infrastructure. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Museums and galleries operated by a registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance operated by a registered charity or local authority, open and accessible to the public, listed as Grade I/II* or Scheduled Monument (or equivalent in Scotland/NI).
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Libraries and archives operated by a registered charity or local authority, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces at libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Performing arts organisations operated by a registered charity or local authority, focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of their education work.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities at performing arts organisations, generally for building or refurbishment of facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations operated by a registered charity, local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to capital projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for places providing excellent care to patients and their families in hospices and palliative care.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, operated by a registered/exempt charity or local authority, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level with special educational needs to develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results, an Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating of 'Good' or above, and demonstrated excellence.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects helping high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment. One-stage application process in 2026 (round now closed; next round expected spring 2027).
